statements.t: While we continue to navigate a dynamic environment – based on our year-to-date results and our expectations for the final quarter of the year – we're raising our outlook for 2026."
The Company's outlook reflects the impact of foreign currency and includes the benefit of IEEPA tariff refunds received in the third quarter.
The Company's previous outlook did not include any benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds.

statements.t: The Company will continue to monitor changes to the import and export policies of the U.S. and other countries that could impact its financial position, results of operations and cash flows.

As of October 3, 2026, the Company had a reserve of $21.4 million, of which $8.4 million is expected to be paid in the next 12 months and is recorded as a current obligation in other accrued liabilities and the remaining $13.0 million is recorded in other liabilities and is expected to be paid over the course of up to 25 years.
The Company expects to use the current borrowings to fund organic growth initiatives and to be used for general corporate purposes.
